title: Zero Crossing
text: Count number of times signal crosses zero in single time step, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Input processing} sets the method to process input signals Columns. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Cnt
ports.summary: Number of zero crossings scalar | row vector
